notes: No UI source, backend code, dataset or model file was modified.
No confirm/import-to-database button was clicked and no persistence was evaluated.
Grid renders incidentally because it is already part of the production page, but no grid screenshot or hierarchy/metric assessment is included.
The pending-request screenshot uses a test-only hold, not artificial UI state and not a model-speed claim.

A test-only fetch observer hashes the FormData File and passes the original FormData unmodified to native fetch; response uploadBytes is also checked. Chromium text postData is not treated as the complete multipart payload.
The report stores transport metadata and actual response summary only, not a second copy of the dataset.
